description: Verify seed topics have been materialized from topic_registry to seed_topics/ directory: directory non-empty, each file has non-empty title, slug set is bidirectionally consistent with registry, trace evidence present, status values point to seed-topics→wave0.

rules.failure_message: seed_topics/ directory is empty. Materialize each topic from topic_registry into seed_topics/<slug>.md files.
Slug consistency check failed. The set of slugs in seed_topics/*.md must be exactly equal to the set of slugs in rb_plan.md topic_registry — no missing, no extra.
A seed topic file has an empty or missing 'title' field in its frontmatter.
A seed topic file's frontmatter 'slug' does not match its filename stem. They must be byte-for-byte equal.
Missing trace event: seed_topics_completion. The phase body requires recording this event in rb_trace.jsonl before running the gate.
rb_status.json current_gate must be 'seed_topics_ready'. Status may have drifted — restore the correct gate value.
rb_status.json next_gate must be 'wave0_complete'. Status may have drifted — restore the correct value.
